purpose: Calibrate observation-layer sensitivity for the source-faithful wigeon phase-retention estimator using an independent ERA5-Land reconstruction paired event-by-event with the frozen NASA POWER reconstruction.

replicate_environment_source.aggregation: provider daily mean; documented as simple 24-hour aggregation of hourly values
replicate_environment_source.role: independent ERA5-Land replicate reconstruction; not claimed byte-identical to the original authors' archived CDS files

published_TGS_contract.daily_rule: tgs_doy = day of minimum cumulative sum(daily_mean_temperature_c - 5)

spatial_temporal_matching.query_coordinate: original reconstructed staging-event latitude and longitude
spatial_temporal_matching.interpolation: none beyond provider nearest ERA5-Land cell selection

primary_disagreement_estimands.warning: Neither quantity is promoted as the true measurement-error SD without additional assumptions.

consecutive_error_dependence.proxy: Pearson correlation of paired-reconstruction phase discrepancies at the origin and destination events of the frozen 224 staging transitions
consecutive_error_dependence.role: sensitivity proxy for consecutive phase-error correlation, not direct identification of the latent source-specific error correlation

lambda_reestimation.power_model: phase_change ~ origin_phase + z_progress + z_endpoint + z_progress:z_endpoint + C(year)
lambda_reestimation.era5land_model: same formula after replacing event TGS with ERA5-Land replicate TGS

attenuation_signal_scale.primary_predictor_variance: sample variance of origin_phase after Frisch-Waugh-Lovell residualization against z_progress + z_endpoint + z_progress:z_endpoint + C(year)
attenuation_signal_scale.reason: The fitted lambda is a partial slope, so raw origin-phase variance is not the relevant attenuation signal variance.

true_lambda_one_sensitivity.decision_rule: No scenario changes the registered W1 result; each is a measurement-error sensitivity / claim audit.

licensed_if_completed: event-level disagreement between two independently reconstructed environmental phase surfaces
sensitivity of naive wigeon lambda to ERA5-Land versus POWER reconstruction
measurement-error null sensitivity under explicitly declared replicate-error assumptions
not_licensed: treating POWER-ERA5 disagreement as a gold-standard measurement error
claiming Open-Meteo output is byte-identical to the original authors' ERA5-Land files
estimating true latent lambda without additional assumptions
changing the registered Aikens lambda analysis or opening its outcome
